energy-conservation-home.alt: A house with labeled ways to save energy: attic insulation and weather stripping keep heat in; LED bulbs use at least 75 percent less electricity than incandescent bulbs; efficient appliances and low-flow fixtures; a programmable thermostat lowers heat or cooling when no one needs it; a shade tree and windbreak (conservation landscaping). A banner lists large-scale measures: vehicle fuel economy, hybrids and electric vehicles, public transportation and green building design.
